blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The dimensional collapse of representations in self-supervised contrastive learning is an ever-present issue. One notable technique to prevent such a collapse of representations is using a multi-layered perceptron network called Projector. In several works, the projector has been found to heavily influence the quality of representations learned in a self-supervised contrastive pre-training task. However, the question still lingers. What role does the projector play? Assuming the projector mitigates dimensional collapse, what prevents the terminal layer of the base encoder from functioning as the projector in the absence of an explicit multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head? In this work, we intend to study what happens inside the projector by examining the rank dynamics of the same and the encoder through empirical study and analysis. Through mathematical analysis, we observe that the effect of rank reduction predominantly occurs in the last layer. Motivated by this insight, we propose a weight regularization strategy applied specifically to the last layer. We demonstrate that this targeted approach yields better performance than applying orthogonal weight regularization across the entire network (WeRank), both with and without a projector. Our method improves Top-1 accuracy by more than 1% on SimCLR on the ImageNet100 dataset and consistently outperforms baseline SimCLR variants on CIFAR datasets, supporting our interpretation of the projector’s role.
blocks.zh: 在自我监督的对比性学习中表现的维度崩溃是一个始终存在的问题. 防止这种表达式崩溃的一个显著技术是使用一个称为Projector的多层透视网络. 在多部作品中,发现投影仪在自我监督的对比性前期训练任务中,对所学表现的质量产生了很大影响. 然而,这个问题仍然存在。 投影机扮演什么角色? 假设投影仪能减轻维的崩溃,那么在没有明确的多层透视头(MLP)的情况下,是什么阻止了基编码器的终端层作为投影仪的功能? 在这项工作中,我们打算研究投影仪内部发生的情况,通过经验研究和分析来检查同类的排名动态和编码器. 通过数学分析,我们看到降级的效果主要发生在最后一层. 基于这一见解,我们提议一项权重正常化战略,专门适用于最后一层。 我们表明,这种有针对性的方法比在整个网络(WeRank)中实行正重调节,无论有无投影仪,都会产生更好的效果。 我们的方法提高了SimCLR在ImageNet100数据集上的Top-1精度超过1%,并且始终比CIFAR数据集的SimCLR基准变体表现好,支持我们对投影仪作用的解释.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning aims to learn representations without any human annotations. Recent works like SimCLR ( Chen et al., 2020a ) , MoCov2 ( Chen et al., 2020b ) , DCL ( Yeh et al., 2022 ) , BYOL ( Grill et al., 2020 ) , Barlow Twins ( Zbontar et al., 2021 ) , etc. present frameworks which allow learning of representations which are similar for semantically similar samples. However, this objective may lead to a complete collapse of representations when the representations of all samples get mapped trivially to a single point in the representation space.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习目的是在没有任何人类说明的情况下学习表现。 近代作品如SimCLR(Chen等人,2020a),MoCov2(Chen等人,2020b),DCL. (Yeh等人,2022年),BYOL(Grill等人,2020年),Barlow Twins(Zbontar等人,2021年)等提出了允许学习类似标本的表述的框架. 然而,当所有样品的表示被略微地映射到代表空间的单一点时,这一目标可能导致表示完全崩溃。

blocks.en:
Various techniques, such as using a large batch size ( Chen et al., 2020a ) , momentum encoder ( Chen et al., 2020b ; Grill et al., 2020 ) , stop gradient ( Chen and He, 2020 ) , feature whitening ( Bardes et al., 2022 ; Zbontar et al., 2021 ) and clustering ( Caron et al., 2020 ) , have been used to prevent the complete collapse of representations. However, contrastive self-supervised learning still suffers from dimensional collapse, where the embedding vectors only span a lower-dimensional subspace. Dimensional collapse
occurs when the variance of information along some dimensions becomes insignificant. We avoid saying that variance will be zero because information content along any dimension can never be entirely zero in practical terms.
blocks.zh:
各种技术,如使用大批量尺寸(Chen等人,2020年a),动力编码器(Chen等人,2020年b;Grill等人,2020年),停止梯度(Chen and He,2020年),特征白化(Bardes等人,2022年;Zbontar等人,2021年)和集群(Caron等人,2020年),都被用于防止代表物完全崩溃. 然而,对比性的自我监督学习仍然受到维度崩溃的困扰,在那里嵌入向量只跨越一个下维子空间. 尺寸崩溃
当某些维度的信息差异变得微不足道时,就会发生。 我们避免说差异将是零的,因为信息内容在任何方面都不可能是实际上完全零的。

blocks.en: In Hua et al. (2021) , the author discusses that dimensional collapse is mainly related to a strong correlation between information flowing through different dimensions. This challenging issue of dimensional collapse has also been addressed in works like Balestriero and LeCun (2022) , RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) , DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) and WeRank ( Pasand et al., 2024 ) . These works also stress the importance of full-rank representations for better performance on downstream tasks. However, WeRank does not provide any mathematical insight into the dimensional collapse of representation. In DirectCLR, the attempt at investigating the causes of the dimensional collapse is limited to toy examples, and only uses a truncated vector for training, leaving the last few dimensions non-trainable. This, however, is not fully capable of preventing dimensional collapse. We instead use the full output vector for both training and evaluation as well. Additionally, WeRank restricts the set of possible learnable functions to a subset satisfying the orthogonality condition of the weight matrices, which causes an over-regularization effect and prevents learning of expressive features. We find several pieces of evidence in the literature, not limited to self-supervised learning, which state that anisotropy is essential for capturing non-uniform data structures, with neural rendering models using it to resolve directional ambiguity and disambiguate geometry from complex appearances for high-fidelity 3D reconstructions ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . In parallel, research on Large Language Models demonstrates that decreasing isotropy via the I-STAR regularizer improves semantic performance by facilitating data clustering and reducing the intrinsic dimensionality of representations ( Rudman and Eickhoff, 2024 ) . Recently, LeJePA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) also stresses that embeddings should be isotropic and that anisotropy amplifies both bias and variance. We show that not enforcing the feature maps to be isotropic via orthogonal weight regularisation, while only regularising the last layer, improves the weight spectrum and reduces the dimensional collapse effect in self-supervised contrastive learning when trained without a projector. Furthermore, we show that, unlike WeRank ( Pasand et al., 2024 ) , it is not necessary to apply the weight regularisation on the whole network, thereby reducing the computation overhead from 𝒪 ⁡ ( L ⋅ n 3 ) \mathcal{O}(L\cdot n^{3}) to 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 3 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{3}) , where L L is the scalar factor that comes naturally, as shown in the later section Sec. 3.6 .
blocks.zh: 在Hua等人(2021年)中,作者讨论到,维度崩溃主要与通过不同维度流动的信息之间的紧密关联有关. Balestriro和LeCun(2022年)等作品也涉及了这个具有挑战性的维断层问题。 我(Garrido等人,2023年),DirectCLR (Jing等人,2022年)和WeRank(Pasand等人,2024年). 这些工作还强调,要更好地完成下游任务,就必须有全方位的代表。 然而,WeRank并没有对代表的维崩溃提供任何数学洞察力. 在DirectCLR中,试图调查维度崩溃原因的尝试仅限于玩具实例,并且只使用短向量进行训练,使得最后几个维度无法训练. 然而,这并不能完全防止维崩溃。 相反,我们也使用全部产出载体进行培训和评价。 此外,WeRank将一套可能的可学习功能限制在一个满足重量矩阵的正交条件的子集中,这造成了过度规范化效应,并阻碍了对表现特征的学习. 我们发现文献中有几件证据,不限于自我监督的学习,其中指出异构对捕捉非统一数据结构至关重要,神经渲染模型用它来解决方向模糊,使几何与高真性3D重建的复杂外观相分离(Wang等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年). 与此同时,关于大语言模型的研究表明,通过I-STAR规范化器减少异构,通过促进数据分组和减少表达的内在维度,提高了语义性能(Rudman and Eickhoff, 2024年)。 最近,LeJepa(Balestriero和LeCun,2025年)也强调嵌入物应该是异热带的,异构会放大偏差和差异. 我们显示,在自我监督的对比性学习中,不强制使用特征图通过正弦重量规范化进行异构化,而只规范最后一层,提高重量谱度,并降低维度崩溃效应。 此外,我们表明,与WeRank(Pasand等人,2024年)不同,没有必要对整个网络实行权重正规化,从而将计算间接费用从O →(L → n 3 )\ mathcal{O}(L\cdot n^{3})降低到O → (n 3)\ mathcal{O}(n^{3}),L L是自然产生的平面系数,见后面第3.6节。

blocks.en: Even though the embedding covariance matrix remains ill-conditioned when a projector is used, we understand that the projector plays an important role in reducing dimensional collapse. The role of the projector has been studied previously in works like Gupta et al. (2022) ; Song et al. (2023) ; Xue et al. (2024) . However, none of the above works explores what the fundamental causes are behind the effect of dimensional collapse.
blocks.zh: 尽管嵌入式共变矩阵在使用投影器时仍然处于不良状态,但我们理解投影器在减少维坍塌方面起着重要作用. 投影仪的作用以前曾在Gupta等人(2022年);Song等人(2023年);薛等人(2024年)等作品中被研究过. 然而,上述任何一部作品都没有探讨维度崩溃效应背后的根本原因.

blocks.en: In this work, we first empirically verify the decorrelating effect of InfoNCE loss. Next, we try to determine what happens inside the projector and its role in self-supervised contrastive learning. We further investigate the phenomenon occurring in the encoder layer that causes degradation in performance in the case of dimensional collapse resulting from negligible eigenvalues of the embedding covariance matrix, both with or without a projector. Finally, we employ a simple strategy for self-supervised learning, both with and without using a projector, which verifies our mathematical conclusion about the role of weight norm. We summarize our contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们首先通过经验验证InfoNCE损失的装饰效果. 接下来,我们试图确定投影仪内部发生的事情,以及它在自我监督的对比性学习中的作用. 我们进一步调查在编码器层中出现的现象,在嵌入式共变矩阵的微小等位值(无论有无投影仪)导致维度崩溃的情况下,这种现象会导致性能退化。 最后,我们用一个简单的策略来进行自我监督的学习,无论是否使用投影仪,它验证了我们对重量规范作用的数学结论. 我们的贡献总结如下:

blocks.en: • We investigate the role of the projector in self-supervised contrastive learning in the light of dimensional collapse. To our knowledge, this is one of the first works to do so. • We further investigate the phenomenon in the encoder when not using a projector for contrastive self-supervised pre-training, giving us more insight into the phenomenon of dimensional collapse. • Based on our findings, we propose a simple strategy to improve performance in contrastive self-supervised pre-training by applying weight regularization only on the last layer. • The proposed regularization strategy outperforms the contemporary regularization strategy WeRank on benchmark datasets CIFAR10, CIFAR100 and ImageNet100.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们调查投影仪在维崩溃的光照下自我监督的对比性学习中的作用. 据我们所知,这是第一批这样做的作品之一。 我们进一步调查编码器中不使用投影仪进行对比性自我监督的前期训练时的现象,使我们更深入地了解维度崩溃的现象. • 根据我们的调查结果,我们提出一个简单的战略,通过只在最后一层进行权重调节,在相互对比的自我监督的前期培训中改进业绩。 拟议的正规化战略在基准数据集CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet100上超过了当代的正规化战略WeRank。

blocks.zh: 根据我们的调查结果,我们提出一个简单的战略,通过只在最后一层实行重量正规化,在对比性的自我监督的前期训练中提高业绩。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: SSL methods take different approaches to prevent a complete collapse of representations. Instance discrimination methods like SimCLR ( Chen et al., 2020a ) , MoCov2 ( Chen et al., 2020b ) , and DCL ( Yeh et al., 2022 ) use repulsion between negative samples to prevent complete collapse. However, in addition to the negative repulsion in the InfoNCE loss, they also use a projector which projects the encoder output representations into a lower-dimensional space before computing the InfoNCE loss. Methods like DeepCluster ( Caron et al., 2018 ) and SwAV ( Caron et al., 2020 ) use a clustering-based instance-group discrimination approach. However, dimensional collapse persists according to Garrido et al. (2023) and Jing et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: SSL方法采取不同的方法来防止表达完全崩溃. SimCLR(Chen等人,2020年a),MoCov2(Chen等人,2020年b),DCL(Yeh等人,2022年)等案例歧视方法在负面样本间使用回力来防止完全崩溃. 然而,除了InfoNCE损失中的负还原外,他们还使用一个投影器,在计算InfoNCE损失之前将编码器输出表示投影到一个下维空间. DeepCluster(Caron等人,2018年)和SWAV(Caron等人,2020年)等方法都采用分组式实例歧视方法. 然而,根据Garrido等人(2023年)和Jing等人(2022年),维度崩塌持续存在.

blocks.en: Architectures similar to the above are also seen in dimension contrastive methods like BYOL ( Grill et al., 2020 ) , where the extra predictor for predicting the output of the projector from the momentum updated target encoder and l ​ 2 l2 -normalization prevents complete collapse. SimSiam ( Chen and He, 2020 ) , on the other hand, uses a stop-gradient method to prevent the same. WMSE ( Ermolov et al., 2021 ) , ZeroCL ( Zhang et al., 2022b ) uses feature whitening to prevent collapse.
blocks.zh: 与上述相似的架构也见于维度对比方法,如BYOL(Grill等人,2020年),其中预测投影仪输出的附加预测器来自动力更新的目标编码器和l2 l2 - 正常化防止完全崩溃. 而西姆西安(英语:Chen and He, 2020)则采用停学法来预防同样的情况. WMSE(Ermolov等人,2021年),ZeroCL (Zhang等人,2022b)使用特征白化来防止崩塌.

blocks.en: Non-contrastive methods like Barlow Twins ( Zbontar et al., 2021 ) aim to decorrelate the feature dimensions to reduce redundancy in the output embeddings, thereby preventing dimensional collapse. However, Barlow Twins fails to perform without the projector, as we will see in the later subsections. VICReg ( Bardes et al., 2022 ) uses a covariance term in the loss to do feature decorrelation like Barlow Twins. However, according to Garrido et al. (2023) , even these methods are not free from dimensional collapse.
blocks.zh: Barlow Twins(Zbontar 等人,2021年)等非重叠方法旨在装饰特征维度以减少输出嵌入中的冗余,从而防止维度崩溃. 然而,Barlow Twins没有投影仪就未能执行,正如我们在后面各小节中看到的. VICReg(Bardes等人,2022年)在损失中使用共变词来进行像Barlow Twins这样的装饰关系. 然而,根据Garrido等人(2023年)的说法,即使这些方法也无法摆脱维崩溃.

blocks.en: Hua et al. (2021) discusses that the strong correlation between dimensions of the representation vector is the primary cause of dimensional collapse, and uses feature decorrelation to prevent it and improve performance. Balestriero and LeCun (2022) also uses a decorrelation loss like VICReg as a method to prevent dimensional collapse and learn optimal representations . Gupta et al. (2022) shows that a projector prevents low-rank backbone features, thereby preventing dimensional collapse. However, it does not explore the reason behind it. This work primarily discusses that a learnable projection head is a way of mitigating the shortcomings of contrastive loss and helps in learning generalizable representations. A detailed discussion of the relationship between downstream performance and embedding rank is also presented in Garrido et al. (2023) . WeRank ( Pasand et al., 2024 ) uses the same feature decorrelation strategy to deduce that the weight norm of each layer should be as close to the identity matrix as possible to prevent dimensional collapse.
blocks.zh: 华等. (2021)讨论表示矢量的维度之间的强烈关联是维度崩溃的主要原因,并使用特征装饰来防止它,提高性能. Balestriero和LeCun(2022年)也使用像VICReg这样的装饰关系损失作为防止维度崩溃和学习最佳表现的方法. Gupta等人(2022年)表明,投影仪可以防止低级骨干特征,从而防止维度崩溃. 然而,它没有探讨其背后的原因。 这项工作主要讨论一个可以学习的投影头是减轻对比性损失缺陷的一种方法,有助于学习概括性表述. Garrido等人(2023年)也详细讨论了下游业绩与嵌入等级之间的关系。 WeRank(Pasand等人,2024年)使用相同的特征装饰策略来推断每个层的权重规范应该尽可能接近身份矩阵,以防止维度崩溃.

blocks.en: DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) achieved considerable success in preventing collapse. This work mainly proposed two findings as the possible causes of dimensional collapse: (1) implicit regularization due to over-parametrization of networks, and (2) strong augmentations. However, in terms of performance (linear evaluation accuracy), it falls short of SimCLR with a non-linear projector.
blocks.zh: DirectCLR(Jing等人,2022年)在防止崩塌方面取得了相当大的成功. 这项工作主要提出两个结论,作为维度崩溃的可能原因:(1)由于网络过于参数化而隐含的规范化,(2)强扩. 然而,就性能(线性评价精度)而言,它与非线性投影仪的SimCLR相差甚远.

blocks.en: DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) introduced self-distillation without labels, where a student network learns from a momentum-updated teacher using normalized feature matching, enabling Vision Transformers to learn semantic features without supervision. iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) extended DINO by combining self-distillation with masked image modelling, allowing simultaneous global and local representation learning through patch-level prediction. DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) further refined the framework with large-scale curated data, improved regularization, and stronger transferability, yielding universal visual features competitive with supervised models. I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) departed from contrastive and pixel-level objectives by predicting high-level latent representations of masked regions, emphasizing abstraction and context understanding. Together, these methods progressively evolve self-supervised learning from instance discrimination toward semantically rich, transferable, and predictive representations.
blocks.zh: DINO(Caron等人,2021年)引入了无标签的自我消化,一个学生网络使用规范化的特征匹配从一个动力更新的教师那里学习,使得Vision Transformers在没有监督的情况下学习语义特征. iBOT(Zhou et al., 2022年)通过将自我沉淀与蒙面图像建模相结合来扩展DINO,使得同时全球和地方代表通过补丁级预测学习. DINOv2(Oquab等人,2024年)进一步完善了框架,采用大规模编译数据,改进规范化,增强可转移性,形成通用视觉特征,与受监督模型竞争. I-JEPA(Asran等人,2023年)偏离了对比和像素层面的目标,预测了蒙蔽区域的高级别潜在表述,强调抽象和背景理解. 这些方法加在一起,逐渐使自我监督的学习从实际歧视向富足、可转移和预测性表述发展。

blocks.en: Other related works, such as VCReg ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , extend the idea of weight and feature regularization by encouraging high-variance and low-covariance representations to enhance feature diversity and prevent neural collapse. This approach aligns conceptually with our method and WeRank ( Pasand et al., 2024 ) , as both aim to improve representation quality and transferability through more balanced and decorrelated feature learning.
blocks.zh: 其他相关作品,如VCReg(Zhu等人,2023年),通过鼓励高变异和低变异表现来扩展重量和特征规范化的理念,以增强特征多样性,防止神经崩溃. 这种方法在概念上符合我们的方法和WeRank(Pasand等人,2024年),两者都旨在通过更加平衡和装饰相关的特征学习提高代表性和可转移性。

blocks.en: The information bottleneck (IB) is a principle for representation learning that aims to extract a compressed representation of a variable that is as predictive as possible of a target variable. The IB framework is based on finding a compressed representation, T T , of an input variable, X X , that preserves the maximum relevant information about a target variable, Y Y . This is expressed through a constrained optimization problem. The goal is to find the representation T T that maximizes the relevance ℐ ⁡ ( T , Y ) \mathcal{I}(T;Y) for a given compression level ℐ ⁡ ( T , X ) \mathcal{I}(T;X) . This can be expressed as a Lagrangian optimization problem: min p ⁡ ( t | x ) ⁡ ℐ ⁡ ( T , X ) − β ​ ℐ ​ ( T , Y ) \min_{p(t|x)}\mathcal{I}(T;X)-\beta\mathcal{I}(T;Y) , where β \beta is the Lagrangian multiplier.

IB框架基于发现一个输入变量X X的压缩表示,T T,它保存了目标变量Y Y的最大相关信息. 这一点通过限制优化问题来表达。 目标是找到代表 T T ,使给定的压缩级I QQ (T, X)\ mathcal{I}(T; Y) 的关联性最大化 。 这可以表示为拉格朗日优化问题:min p ⁡ (t | x ) ⁡ I ⁡ (T, X ) β (T, Y )\min_{p(t|x) }\ mathcal{I}(T;X)-\β\ mathcal{I}(T;Y),其中β\ββ是拉格朗日的乘数.

blocks.en:
High-level representations refer to feature spaces that encode abstract, class-discriminative, and view-invariant semantic attributes of the input data while discarding task-irrelevant, low-level spatial variations.
In deep architectures, feature extraction is hierarchical; earlier layers capture local spatial primitives, whereas the terminal layers (such as layer L L ) map these primitives into high-level semantic representations. Consequently, weight degradation or rank collapse at layer L L directly impairs the network’s capacity to output well-conditioned high-level features suitable for downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
高层表示法是指在放弃与任务无关,低级空间变异的同时,对输入数据抽象,类差异性,和视图不变量语义属性进行编码的特征空间.
在深层建筑中,特征提取是分层的;早期的地层捕捉到当地的空间原始物,而终端地层(如L层L)将这些原始物映射成高层次的语义表示. 因此,LL层的重量退化或分级崩溃直接损害网络输出适合下游任务的、条件良好的高水平特性的能力。

blocks.en: Relevance to Downstream Tasks : The principle of information bottleneck is utilised in the downstream task to discard irrelevant information while retaining useful information related to the downstream task. The high-level representations, that is, the task-specific representations in the deeper layers, are also relevant to the downstream task. Finally, the dimensional collapse, which can occur for both the self-supervised pre-training and supervised training stages, causes the learning to occur in a lower-dimensional subspace rather than in the high-dimensional embedding space. A larger utilisation of the learning subspace results in better performance in the downstream task.
blocks.zh: 与下游的相关性 任务 : 在下游任务中,信息瓶颈原则被用来丢弃无关信息,同时保留与下游任务有关的有用信息。 高级别代表,即更深层次的具体任务代表,也与下游任务有关。 最后,对于自我监督的预训阶段和受监督的训练阶段都可能发生的维度崩溃导致学习发生在低维次空间而不是高维嵌入空间. 更多地利用学习子空间可以提高下游任务的业绩。

blocks.en: 3.3 Theoretical Setup and Scope
blocks.zh: 3.3 理论设置和范围

blocks.en: In this subsection, we formalize the modelling assumptions under which the theoretical analysis in the subsequent sections is carried out. This setup is not a repetition of the preliminaries in Sec. 3.1 , but rather a restriction of scope that specifies which components of the network and training objective are explicitly modelled and which are abstracted away.
blocks.zh: 在这一小节中,我们正式确定了进行以下各节理论分析的建模假设。 这种设置并不是重复第3.1节中的预设,而是对范围的限制,它具体规定了网络和培训目标的哪些组成部分是明确模拟的,哪些是抽象的。

blocks.en: We consider an InfoNCE-based contrastive SSL framework with a convolutional neural network (CNN) encoder f f , optionally followed by a projection head g g , as introduced in Sec. 3.1 . While a projector is not strictly required for all self-supervised learning paradigms (e.g., DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) ), it is a standard architectural component in InfoNCE-based contrastive frameworks such as SimCLR and has been shown to play an important role in stabilising training and mitigating representation collapse. Accordingly, the presence of a projector is assumed in the general setup, while its absence is treated as a special case that is analyzed explicitly in later sections.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑一个基于 InfoNCE 的对比性SSL 框架,其中包含一个进化神经网络(CNN)编码器 f f ,可选的后面加上一个投影头 g g, 如 Sec 中引入的. 3.1 (韩语). 虽然所有自我监督的学习范式(如DirectCLR(Jing等人,2022年))并不严格需要投影仪,但它是SimCLR等基于InfoNCE的对比性框架的标准建筑构件,并已被证明在稳定培训和减轻代表崩溃方面发挥着重要作用. 因此,在一般设置中假定有投影仪存在,而没有投影仪则被视为一种特殊情况,将在后面各节中明确分析。

blocks.en: Although the encoder f f consists of multiple convolutional layers, our analysis is intentionally restricted to the final two convolutional layers of the encoder and the layers of the projector. All earlier layers are treated as a black box that produces intermediate feature representations with well-defined second-order statistics (i.e., finite covariance).
blocks.zh: 虽然编码器ff由多个转录层组成,但我们的分析被故意限制在编码器和投影器的两层最后. 所有早期的层都被视为一个黑匣子,产生中间特征表示,并带有定义明确的二阶统计(即有限共变).

blocks.en:
This restriction is motivated by empirical observations showing that dimensional collapse and rank degradation emerge most prominently at the layer whose output is directly optimized by the contrastive loss (shown in later sections). Consequently, all propositions in this paper concern the behaviour of:
(i) the final encoder layer when no projector is used, or
(ii) the projector layers when a projection head is present.
blocks.zh:
这种限制的动机是经验观察显示,在输出直接被对比性损失优化的层层(在后面各节显示),维度崩溃和分级降解最突出. 因此,本文件中的所有提议都涉及下列行为:
未使用投影仪时的最后编码层,或
(二) 投影头出现时投影层。

blocks.en: Throughout the paper, we denote by layer L L the layer whose output embedding is used to compute the InfoNCE loss. In this work, layer l − 1 l-1 is termed a shallower layer with respect to l l , while the layer l l is deeper with respect to the layer l − 1 l-1 . While there is no specific threshold in the literature to specify which layers are deep or shallow, by the term “deep” we will consider layers which are close to the final layer L L , while “shallow” layers indicate those closer to the input layer.
blocks.zh: 整个纸上,我们用L层表示其输出嵌入用于计算InfoNCE损失的层. 在这项工作中,L-1-1层与l-1相比称为较浅的层,而l-1层与l-1层相比称为较深的层。 虽然文献中没有具体的阈值来说明哪些层是深层或浅层,但通过“深层”一词,我们将考虑接近最后一层L L的层,而“浅层”则表示那些更接近输入层的层。

blocks.en: For analytical tractability, the layers under consideration (i.e., the last two encoder layers and the projector layers) are modelled as linear transformations parameterized by weight matrices. Non-linear activations, batch normalization, and skip connections are omitted from the theoretical analysis. This simplification allows us to isolate the structural relationship between embedding covariance, weight norms, and dimensional collapse.

blocks.en: In this work, the main motivation is to study the phenomenon occurring inside the projector in the self-supervised contrastive learning scenario and what happens in the absence of it. In DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) , it is stated that in instance discrimination-based contrastive learning, even though the presence of positive and negative samples should prevent the dimensional collapse of representations intuitively, it still occurs.

blocks.en: 3.5 Does InfoNCE have a decorrelating effect?
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 InfoNCE 是否有装饰效果?

blocks.en: According to Zhang et al. (2022a) , InfoNCE also acts as a decorrelating loss, similar to Barlow Twins ( Zbontar et al., 2021 ) or Balestriero and LeCun (2022) . In Fig. 2(a) and 2(b) , we show the covariance matrix of the output feature dimensions. From the covariance matrix of the embeddings of the CIFAR100 and ImageNet100 datasets, we can see that the magnitudes of the diagonal elements of the covariance matrix are much higher than the non-diagonal ones. This shows that the InfoNCE loss has a decorrelating effect, as shown in Zhang et al. (2022a) . However, from Fig. 2(c) and 2(d) , we see that the diagonal nature of the covariance matrix of the encoder output embeddings is not present. This proves that even if the loss enforces feature decorrelation on the projector output embeddings, it is possible to obtain low-rank output embeddings from the encoder.
blocks.zh: 根据张等人(2022a)的说法,InfoNCE也起到装饰损失的作用,类似于Barlow Twins(Zbontar等人,2021年)或Balestriero和LeCun(2022年). 在图2(a)和2(b)中,我们显示了输出特征维度的共变矩阵. 从CIFAR100和ImageNet100数据集嵌入的共变矩阵中可以看出,共变矩阵的对角元素的大小远高于非对角元素. 这表明InfoNCE损失具有装饰效果,如张等(2022a)所示. 然而,从图2(c)和2(d)来看,我们看到编码器输出嵌入物的共变矩阵的对角性质并不存在. 这证明,即使损失在投影器输出嵌入物上执行特征装饰,也可以从编码器中获取低级输出嵌入物.

blocks.en: 3.6 Understanding the events in Projector in case of Dimensional Collapse
blocks.zh: 3.6 国家 在大小折叠情况下了解投影仪中的事件

blocks.en:
It is empirically observed in DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) that InfoNCE loss fails to properly optimize the parameters of a network without a projector and results in dimensional collapse. Barlow Twins (BT) ( Zbontar et al., 2021 ) performs better than most contrastive learning frameworks on benchmark datasets, but not when implemented without a projector, even though a decorrelation loss is applied.
The singular value spectrum in Fig. 1(b) plots the singular values of BT (w/o projector), SimCLR (w/o projector), and DirectCLR. We can see that the dimensional collapse effect in BT is greater than in SimCLR w/o projector, even though it is trained directly using a decorrelation-based loss. According to Zhang et al. (2022a) , the projector is essential for a decorrelation-based framework too, even though both InfoNCE and the loss used in Zbontar et al. (2021) have a decorrelating component. So, the question arises, what exactly happens after the addition of a non-linear projector towards the prevention of dimensional collapse? .
blocks.zh:
在DirectCLR(Jing等人,2022年)中经验观测到,InfoNCE损失未能适当优化一个没有投影仪的网络的参数,并导致维崩溃. Barlow Twins(BT)(Zbontar等人,2021年)在基准数据集上的表现优于大多数对比性的学习框架,但在没有投影仪的情况下执行时不会,尽管采用了装饰关系损失.
图1(b)中的单值频谱绘制了BT(w/o投影仪)、SimCLR(w/o投影仪)和DirectCLR的单值。 我们可以看到,BT中的维崩溃效应大于SimCLR w/o投影器,尽管直接使用装饰关系损失来训练. Zhang等人(2022a)认为,投影仪对于基于装饰关系的框架也是必不可少的,尽管InfoNCE和Zbontar等人(2021年)使用的损失都有一个装饰组件. 问题是,在添加非线性投影仪以防止维度崩溃之后究竟会发生什么? 。 。 。

blocks.en: In RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) and DirectCLR ( Jing et al., 2022 ) , the authors have shown that without a projector, the embeddings from the pre-trained encoder have a low rank. Does a low-rank embedding indicate that the useful information can be approximated using fewer dimensions? But then, why does it lead to worse performance, if that is the case? . How is it different from the information bottleneck theory of the projector? ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在RankMe(Garrido等人,2023年)和DirectCLR(Jing等人,2022年)中,作者都表明没有投影仪,来自预训编码器的嵌入器的级别较低. 低档嵌入是否表明有用信息可以用更少的维度进行近似? 但是,如果情况是这样,为什么它导致业绩恶化? 。 。 。 与投影仪的信息瓶颈理论有何不同?. (欧阳等人,2025年).

blocks.en: 3.6.1 Weight Norm Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.6.1 重量标准分析

blocks.en: We look at the distribution of the channel-wise weight norms of the convolutional layers in the penultimate and last layer of the encoder (Fig. 3 ), trained using the SimCLR framework, but without a projector. We can observe that there are several samples in the distributions which have values very close to zero, indicating the presence of collapsed dimensions. Additionally, we also present the effect of applying a weight regularization in the last layer only when trained without a projector in the same figure.
blocks.zh: 我们用SimCLR框架来研究进化层倒数第二层和最后一个层(图3)的信道偏重规范的分布,但没有投影仪。 我们可以观察到,分布中有几个样本的值非常接近零,表明存在坍塌的维度. 此外,我们还介绍了只有在没有同样数字的投影仪的训练下,才在最后一层实行重量调节的效果。

blocks.en: The importance of these empirical findings lies in the fact that they directly corroborate the “Key Takeaway 1” mentioned previously. By definition, the last layer corresponds to learning the high-level and more complex representations. Having a negligible weight norm and a negligible variance reduces the representation learning capacity of the layers in concern. From Figs. 3 and 5(b) , we can combine the empirical results to infer that in the absence of a projector, both the covariance of the embedding dimensions and the weight norm become negligible along a few dimensions. Hence, considering that the concerned weights are from the last layer, we can safely state that the kernels in the deeper layers are incapable of learning useful information in the absence of a projector.
blocks.zh: 这些经验性调查结果的重要性在于它们直接证实了前面提到的“关键竹竿1”。 顾名思义,最后一层对应学习高层次,更复杂的表述. 加权标准可忽略不计,差异可忽略不计,从而降低所涉各层的代表学习能力。 从图3和图5(b)中,我们可以结合经验结果推断,在没有投影仪的情况下,嵌入维度和重量规范的共性在几个维度上都变得微不足道。 因此,考虑到相关的权重来自最后一层,我们可以安全地说,在没有投影仪的情况下,更深层的内核无法学习有用的信息.

blocks.zh: 3.6.2 宣传低口径代表

blocks.en: In the case of a perfect decorrelating effect of the InfoNCE loss as discussed in the previous subsection, the flow of information would be maximized, resulting in better semantic representation learning and consequently better downstream performance. But the decorrelation effect of the InfoNCE on the encoder output embeddings does not maximize the flow of information through the encoder output dimensions . A similar approach to prevent dimensional collapse was also presented in WeRank ( Pasand et al., 2024 ) , where the authors used weight regularization by whitening the weight covariance matrix.
blocks.zh: 如果如上一节所述,InfoNCE损失的完美装饰效应,信息流动将最大化,从而改进语义性表现学习,从而改善下游业绩。 但InfoNCE对编码器输出嵌入的装饰关系效应并不能通过编码器输出维度实现信息流动最大化. . 在WeRank(Pasand等人,2024年)中也提出了防止维度崩溃的类似方法,作者通过将重量共变矩阵白化使用重量规范.

We see an increase in the number of high-valued singular values in the final layer of the backbone when using a projector. However, the eigenvalue spectrum is almost unchanged with or without a projector in the penultimate layer of the ResNet backbone encoder. Thus, we can say that the effect of rank reduction is observed only on the final layer, when not using a separate projector, and the final layer of the backbone acts as the make-shift or pseudo projector . However, according to our observation, it is wise to say that the rank reduction effect is observed on the layer from which the final embedding is taken for contrastive loss computation, while the eigenspectrum of the previous layer output embeddings shows almost no change. This is confirmed from the plots of eigenvalues in Fig. 6 , where we observe that the eigenvalues for the last layer of the projector are significantly low in magnitude.

blocks.en: The trick used in DirectCLR is to leave a part of the output vector z z randomly initialized, theoretically making the variance of those dimensions non-zero. This causes the encoder to learn representations that are effectively higher-dimensional. Therefore, separability is also better according to Cover’s theorem ( Cover, 1965 ) . Whereas, when the rank gets reduced, the representations are mapped to a low-dimensional subspace which should reduce the probability that the mapped instances are linearly separable while still being embedded in a high-dimensional space.
blocks.zh: DirectCLR中使用的技巧是将输出矢量z z的一部分随机初始化,理论上使这些维度的差异非零. 这使得编码器能够学习有效的更高维度的表示. 因此,根据Cover的定理(Cover,1965年),可分离性也更好。 而当级别降低时,表示图被映射到一个低维的子空间,这将减少所映射的事件在仍嵌入高维空间的同时线性分离的可能性。

blocks.en: A common premise in the literature, often motivated by frameworks like RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) is that higher-rank embeddings directly correlate with superior downstream performance. RankMe evaluates a within-method, cross-hyperparameter relationship between representation rank and linear evaluation performance within a single, consistent feature space. In contrast, evaluating pre-projector features h ∈ ℝ D h h\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{h}} versus post-projector features z ∈ ℝ D z z\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{z}} within the same trained network involves projections across spaces with fundamentally different ambient dimensions ( D h ≠ D z D_{h}\neq D_{z} ) and distinct functional roles. The projection head intentionally maps h h into z z to isolate loss-specific decorrelation, whereas h h retains a richer, multi-dimensional semantic hierarchy optimized for general linear separability. Because h h and z z reside in distinct ambient spaces, comparing their absolute ranks directly does not imply that z z is a superior representation overall. Instead, rank dynamics across the pre- and post-projector boundary reflect geometric transformations between distinct feature spaces rather than a naive "higher rank implies better representation" rule.

blocks.en: A collapsed principal component mode of the representation at layer l l , characterized by a near-zero output eigenvalue ( λ i ​ ( Σ h ) ≤ ϵ \lambda_{i}(\Sigma_{h})\leq\epsilon ), arises from multiple, non-exclusive spectral mechanisms rather than a single structural bottleneck. First, even when the input covariance Σ l − 1 \Sigma_{l-1} and intermediate weights W l − 1 W_{l-1} are strictly full-rank and well-conditioned, collapse along an output principal direction 𝐮 i \mathbf{u}_{i} can occur due to inter-layer spectral misalignment, where the projected weight vector 𝐮 i T ​ W l \mathbf{u}_{i}^{T}W_{l} falls into the approximate left nullspace of W l − 1 W_{l-1} . Second, collapse occurs when the composite transformation 𝐮 i T ​ W l ​ W l − 1 \mathbf{u}_{i}^{T}W_{l}W_{l-1} is spectrally misaligned with the dominant eigenspaces of the input covariance Σ l − 1 \Sigma_{l-1} , or when W l W_{l} undergoes directional weight shrinkage along 𝐮 i \mathbf{u}_{i} . Consequently, observing a low-rank or collapsed representation spectrum at layer l l does not automatically imply rank deficiency in shallower weight matrices ( W l − 1 W_{l-1} ) or input embeddings. blocks.en: The empirical results provided in Tables 3.6.3 combined with Fig. 7 indicate that we cannot observe the same information bottleneck effect without a projector. From the discussion in this subsection, we can safely say that the role of the projector is not only that of an information bottleneck, which is observed from the ineffectiveness of the forced collapse on the encoder output. The driving factor behind the effectiveness of the projector is that it allows the encoder to learn more high-level representations and, consequently, better separability with a higher rank of the embedding covariance matrix. Whereas a collapse in the last layer of the encoder prevents it from learning useful representations, which are essential for the effective classification of the input samples, as the norm of several kernels will be reduced to zero. With a constant subvector in the output, the weights are not updated to learn useful representations. Furthermore, being unable to learn essential representations also diminishes the mutual information between the input and the output and the generalization error bound, which we prove in the next subsection.

blocks.en: Enforcing W . W T = I W.W^{T}=I at the last layer improves SimCLR by conditioning the embedding geometry seen by the contrastive objective and preventing projector-induced anisotropy. This suggests that spectral conditioning is most effective when applied locally to the contrastive embedding space rather than globally to all feature transformations.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this work, we presented a layer-wise linear algebraic framework to characterize the multiple possible mechanisms of dimensional collapse, specifically isolating weight norm shrinkage, inter-layer spectral misalignment, and feature covariance misalignment. While our proposed targeted weight regularization ( W ​ W ⊤ = I WW^{\top}=I ) effectively mitigates weight-induced rank collapse in the last layer, it primarily addresses weight norm decay without explicitly constraining inter-layer or feature-space directional alignments. In future work, we plan to develop a unified optimization framework that jointly addresses spectral and feature-space misalignment, offering a more comprehensive solution to dimensional collapse. Additionally, while our theoretical setup and empirical validations focus specifically on InfoNCE-based contrastive learning architectures with CNN backbones, extending this last-layer rank analysis to non-contrastive self-supervised paradigms (e.g., feature decorrelation ( Bardes et al., 2022 ) or predictive architectures ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) ) and Transformer-based backbones ( ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) presents an exciting direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了一个分层的线性代数框架,以描述维度崩溃的多种可能机制,具体来说是隔离权重规范缩水,层间光谱错配,以及特征共变错配. 虽然我们提议的定点重量规范化(W W = I WW = Top = I)有效缓解了上一层的重量引起的排名崩溃,但它主要处理重量规范衰减问题,而没有明确限制层间或特征-空间方向对齐. 在未来的工作中,我们计划制定统一的优化框架,共同解决光谱和特征-空间错位问题,为维崩溃提供更全面的解决方案. 此外,虽然我们的理论设置和经验验证特别侧重于基于InfoNCE的对比性学习架构与CNN的骨干,但将这一最后一层的排名分析扩展到非冲突性的自我监督范式(例如,特征装饰(Bardes等人,2022年)或预测性架构(Asran等人,2023年;Balestriero和LeCun,2025年))和基于变形器的骨干(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年),为未来的研究提供了令人振奋的方向.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate the main reason behind the effectiveness of the projector in preventing dimensional collapse. We analyze mathematically the phenomenon that happens inside the projector and the encoder when trained without a projector. We find that the projector not only creates an information bottleneck but also facilitates the learning of high-level representations in the encoder; without it, a dimensional collapse at the encoder output prevents such learning. We also devise a solution to improve performance by applying weight regularization only to the last layer, with or without a projector, achieving performance better than WeRank, which uses weight regularization across the whole network. We leave the study of the cause of dimensional collapse for our future work.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查了投影仪在防止维度崩溃方面的有效性背后的主要原因. 我们从数学上分析 投影仪和编码器内部发生的情况, 没有投影仪。 我们发现投影仪不仅制造了信息瓶颈,还有利于在编码器中学习高层次的表示;没有它,编码器输出的维崩溃会阻止这样的学习. 我们还设计了一个提高性能的解决方案,将重量规范化应用到最后一层,无论有无投影仪,实现性能优于整个网络使用重量规范化的WeRank. 我们把研究维度崩溃的原因留给我们今后的工作。
